Class ECSModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • ecs_architecture.standard.ECSModel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:

      • internalAdd

        protected final void internalAdd​(GameComponent... gameComponents)
        Adds components to a new entity. A randomly generated ID is assigned to the entity and mapped to its components

        This ID can be retrieved by using get(Class) method to acquire a group of components of the same type mapped to entity IDs, and calling Map.keySet(). The ID can also be acquired by using methods like Map.forEach which have a consumer parameter that accepts a String id and GameComponent

        To protect the IDs from being tampered with and to enforce an Entity-Component-System design, component IDs should only ever be exposed in similar ways to the ones described above

        Parameters:
        gameComponents - the specified components to add to the entity
